description.value: Ventura Room is an intimate cocktail bar on Cambie Street in Vancouver, formerly known as the Media Club, specializing in carefully curated cocktails alongside small plates. The venue hosts live music and events and has both indoor and outdoor seating. A touring cyclist stopping in the evening would find a lively neighbourhood bar with table reservations available.
